product_decisions.decision: Adopt the design system and capability-driven multi-provider platform
Do not implement Cursor Agent as a personal quota provider until an official consumer usage-summary API exists
Treat EP-004 as targeted cleanup, not a full provider-platform rewrite

product_decisions.impact: Canonicalize imports, deprecate aliases, enrich metadata, choose one retry owner

product_decisions.decision: Product-as-demo: showcase/demos.json lists AI Tray (id main, type desktop) via GitHub Releases; no duplicate playground or Flutter Web embed
product_decisions.rationale: RSProjects Demo Standard: application repositories use the product as the demo; tray/CLI/sidecar cannot embed on web
product_decisions.impact: demos.json product entry; reusable-flutter-web-demo.yml for other RSProjects only; DEMO_STRATEGY.md

product_decisions.decision: Branded FlexColorScheme personalization with custom theme presets, bundled fonts, and app-icon architecture
product_decisions.rationale: Selectable appearance without rewriting tray surfaces; offline desktop forbids runtime font downloads
product_decisions.impact: lib/theme module; Settings Appearance pickers; settings_v1 persistence; ADR-005

product_decisions.decision: Adaptive menu-bar title density with configurable reveal threshold; monochrome template glyph
product_decisions.rationale: Persistent percentage in the menu bar is noisy; premium extras should stay quiet until attention is useful
product_decisions.impact: TrayDisplayMode + settings; concise native tray menu

product_decisions.decision: Ship V2 Milestone 1 (Session Browser + Detail) and Milestone 2 (manual resume, Resume Queue, NotificationGateway, click-to-resume); Milestone 3 (Resume Scheduler) and Session Analytics remain deferred
product_decisions.rationale: First mutating capability the app has shipped; safety model requires a mandatory budget cap and no unattended cancellation before any scheduler work is justified

product_decisions.decision: Repository enters release freeze for open-source readiness; no new features until docs/release-engineering/OSS scaffold are confirmed consistent with shipped code; repo visibility remains a separate Product Owner decision
product_decisions.rationale: docs/project/* had drifted a full PR plus a merged feature milestone behind main; OSS-facing docs already assume the repo is public when it is still private
product_decisions.impact: This freeze pass; see ROADMAP.md exit criteria
